a.lede: The Noctua Edition replaces the original WireView Pro II cooling solution with a semi-passive design that can handle up to 300W without active cooling and runs below 2,000 RPM when the fan is needed.
a.title: Noctua upgrades Thermal Grizzly's 12V-2x6 power monitor

b.lede: Noctua and Forced Physics are exploring whether densely packed micro-channels can provide extreme cooling performance without the noise associated with high-pressure airflow
b.title: Noctua explores 2,000W micro-channel air cooling
